mapper.select: SELECT mr.id, mr.patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, mr.doctor_id, u.name AS doctor_name, mr.record_date, mr.chief_complaint, mr.present_illness, mr.physical_examination, mr.diagnosis, mr.treatment_plan, mr.medication, mr.remarks FROM medical_record mr LEFT JOIN patient p ON mr.patient_id = p.id LEFT JOIN doctor d ON mr.doctor_id = d.id LEFT JOIN user u ON d.user_id = u.id WHERE mr.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO medical_record (patient_id, doctor_id, record_date, chief_complaint, present_illness, physical_examination, diagnosis, treatment_plan, medication, remarks) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{doctorId}, #{recordDate}, #{chiefComplaint}, #{presentIllness}, #{physicalExamination}, #{diagnosis}, #{treatmentPlan}, #{medication}, #{remarks})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record WHERE record_date = #{date}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record WHERE YEAR(record_date) = #{year} AND MONTH(record_date) = #{month}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record WHERE patient_id = #{patientId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM medical_record WHERE doctor_id = #{doctorId}
